intro.title: Six-eight time
intro.text: 6/8 has six eighth notes per bar, grouped in two sets of three. It's felt as two big beats, each a dotted quarter: “1-2-3, 4-5-6”.

intro.title: Two clicks a bar
intro.text: The metronome clicks on the two big beats, and the tempo counts them. The long-short pattern (quarter, eighth) gives 6/8 its lilt.
